notes: AI-generated illustrative catering catalog images based on user-provided dish descriptions; not photographs of executed catering events. Original PNG outputs copied unmodified from Codex generated_images to the project. Each asset generated with a separate tool call; no stock substitution.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: Indian catering menu catalog photograph, landscape 3:2 composition.
Primary request: palak paneer in one LARGE rectangular brushed stainless-steel gastronorm buffet pan.
Subject: deep green spinach curry containing clearly recognizable cubes of Indian paneer cheese, with onion, ginger and tomato cooked into the spinach. The curry must be deep spinach green, not orange. Generous catering quantity, not a single portion.
Scene/backdrop: clean neutral buffet table, uncluttered softly blurred neutral background.
Composition/framing: 45-degree slightly overhead view; the rectangular pan fills most of the frame with its brushed steel rim visible on all sides. Food is centered and remains recognizable under common website card crops. Close enough to see natural spinach texture and paneer surfaces.
Lighting/mood: warm, soft natural light, appetizing realistic food photography, believable texture and gentle metal reflections.
Constraints: one main gastronorm pan; no people, hands, text, letters, branding, logos, watermarks, single-portion plates, or utensils obscuring the food. No orange sauce.

visualReview.observations: Deep green spinach curry, recognizable paneer cubes and visible onion/tomato; large steel buffet pan; no text or people.

assets.prompt:
